name: gopal chowkdi
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (57%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL), CORN STARCH (7.5%), SUGAR, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (DRY MANGO POWDER, CHILLI POWDER), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330), EDIBLE COMMON SALT (BLACK SALT), RAISING AGENT (INS 500(II), INS 500(I)) AND FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT (INS 170(1)). ALLERGEN ADVICE: CONTAINS WHEAT MAY CONTAINS CEREALS CONTAINING GLUTEN, MILK, TREE NUTS, PEANUTS, SESAME SEEDS, MUSTARD SEEDS AND SOYA.
